Original right quotient t*exp(-t)->0 at t=1/h->infinity, left quotient zero. Exponential dominates every polynomial, so derivative joins continuously and all subsequent derivatives at zero vanish. Lazy branch avoids the reciprocal at zero.

Between integers differentiate t²(1-t)². At integer n original quotients h(1-h)² from right and h(1+h)² from left both tend to zero. Endpoint slopes of derivative give f"=2; third derivatives differ ±12. Formula includes every integer and is periodic.
